name: Omero Mumba
biography: Omero Mumba was born in Dublin, Ireland on July 2nd 1989 and is the younger brother of Irish Actress and R&B superstar Samantha Mumba. Already Omero is confidently following in his big sister's footsteps, having appeared on stage with her many times. Omero also performed his rap music on their single "The Boy". On a UK TV appearance in January 2001, Samantha predicted that Omero would be a big star, and there's every indication that she's right. Omero had great fun making his first film The Time Machine (2002), and enjoyed every minute. After filming was completed he appeared in the US with Samantha and NSync. Having recently signed a recording contract himself, Omero also hopes to have time to 'do some of his own stuff' too.
